name: FlatSQL Store (in-wasm OD-flow write lane)
description: In-wasm FlatSQL store terminal for the supplemental-OMM OD flow, on FlatBuffers-only typed contracts. Takes size-prefixed $OMM/$OCM/$OBD records on per-standard ports (omm_records/ocm_records/obd_records, one record per frame), computes each record's CIDv1, skips records already stored (read-only SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE cid=? via import_module('flatsql')/import_name('exec_envelope')), and ingests the rest as a wrapper FlatBuffer { cid; provider; source_name; batch_id; data; pulled_at } with store-local file_identifier SOMM/SOCM/SOBD into the FlatSQL arena (flatsql.ingest_record). Per-record provider/source_name come from an IngestRequest (INGQ) on 'provenance' keyed by PROVENANCE.NORMALIZED_SHA256 (hex SHA-256 of the record bytes), else from the node config (ModuleConfig via plugin.getConfig: provider, source_name, batch_id, retain_k). batch_id and pulled_at are fire-scoped from the optional TimerTick (TICK) trigger's FIRED_MS. Keeps the latest retain_k runs per table (default 4; flatsql.query_rows / mark_deleted_bulk / compact). Answers one IngestResult (INGR). $OEM is never stored.

methods.description: Per record: CIDv1, skip when already stored, else ingest a wrapper FlatBuffer (cid/provider/source_name/batch_id/data/pulled_at) into the FlatSQL arena; then keep the latest retain_k runs per table. Provenance per record from INGQ frames, fallback node config. One IngestResult out.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer record per frame (the fitted OD result).

inputPorts.description: Fitted $OMM records to store in sds_omm. Frames across omm/ocm/obd_records are stored in arrival order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $OCM FlatBuffer record per frame (the fitted OD result).

inputPorts.description: Fitted $OCM records to store in sds_ocm. Frames across omm/ocm/obd_records are stored in arrival order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $OBD FlatBuffer record per frame (the fitted OD result).

inputPorts.description: Fitted $OBD records to store in sds_obd. Frames across omm/ocm/obd_records are stored in arrival order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ), one per record: PROVENANCE.NORMALIZED_SHA256 = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the record's size-prefixed bytes; TAGS.PROVIDER_ID and TAGS.SOURCE_NAME are the record's attribution. SCHEMA names the record's standard.

inputPorts.description: Per-record provider/source_name attribution (keyed by record digest); empty or absent falls back to the node config.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK): FIRED_MS is the fire's wall-clock time.

inputPorts.description: Optional fire tick: batch_id = 'F' + 16 hex digits of FIRED_MS and pulled_at = FIRED_MS for every store() of the fire.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (module-sdk runtime type INGR): PROVIDER_ID / SOURCE_NAME (node config), BATCH_ID (the fire's), INSERTED, RECONCILED_DUPLICATES (records whose cid was already stored), RECONCILED_OLD_BATCHES (records tombstoned by retention). SCHEMA is empty: one invocation spans $OMM/$OCM/$OBD.

outputPorts.description: EXACTLY ONE IngestResult per successful invocation.
